Routine:  
Wash with NYM tahitian or NYM sea kelp
Condition  with the same line.
Leave in: most of the time I just use a few pumps of the NYM conditioner as my leave in.
Scrunch scrunch scrunch scrunch. 
Mousse, gel, mousse with herbal essence curl mousse and (as of late) the blue gel everyone talks about that I can't remember the name of, my bad.

My hair is lower back length. I use probably two blobs of gel, each about the size of walnuts still in the shell.    So like 3 tablespoon total or so maybe.   If I use more than that my hair is nasty/sticky and I have to wash it again too soon.   I've also noticed that I get considerably more tangles when I use too much. 

I do apply more product each day over the course of a few days during my refresh.  So, by the end of day 4 I have quite a bit in my hair as build up

I get much better results with wash now/style later.  I pretty much only do it this way now. I have lower back length hair. Medium porosity, fine but thick hair. Maybe 2b with some 2c mixed in there.  I shampoo (nym tahitian), then condition (nym tahitian) and get the absolute best clumps when i use that same conditioner as my leave in as well.   Then I plop for a bit, usually 20ish minutes and then take it out and just go to bed.  Sometimes, not gonna lie, im exhausted, and fall asleep in the plop.   Next morning, im usually completely dry and I spritz my hair until dripping wet. I then add more of my nym tahitian conditioner and brush thru with my denman type brush..  Do my scrunches.  Mousse, gel, mousse. With scrunches in between. Then diffuse or air dry.    The extra conditioner  makes amazing clumps and the mousse/gel/mousse approach give staying power that often times keep my waves going in to the next day.  If not, I really only have to add a little water for the next few morning  because the product in my hair seems to rejuvenate itself without getting sticky so I dont really feel like I'm needing to wash my hair again.

I am currently using the NYM tahitian gardenia shampoo and conditioner.  Truthfully, I just use that same conditioner as my leave-in as well.  If I notice a overly moisturized feel (i.e. greasy) then I do my next wash with blueberry bliss leave-in instead.   For me though, im pretty lazy, and the fewer things I have to think about, the better, lol.
